description: Piste ciclabili is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geonext.comune.modena.it. Existing and planned cycle paths, including information on the location (mixed, own), type, level, etc. This is not a real topological graph, as the geometries of the individual sections of the cycle path are interrupted at crossings. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Cycle paths" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://w3id.org/italia/controlled-vocabulary/licences/A21_CCBY40). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
